recalled_knowledge.item: atomic masses I 126.904 u, Na 22.990 u
DAMA modulation phase t0 = 152.5 d (2 June)
DAMA/LIBRA single-hit rate ~ 1 cpd/kg/keV at 10-60 keVee
DAMA/LIBRA exposure 2.46 t yr (phase1 1.33 + phase2 1.13 to 2018); later updates ~2.9 t yr
DAMA S_m consistent with zero above ~6 keVee at the 1e-3 cpd/kg/keV level, per-0.5-keV-bin errors ~0.002-0.003 at 6-20 keVee; positive 0.01-0.02 at 2-6 keVee
COSINE-100 exposure ~0.2 t yr, background ~3 cpd/kg/keV, null S_m at ~0.005 cpd/kg/keV
ANAIS-112 exposure ~0.3 t yr (3 yr) to ~0.6 t yr (2025), background ~3 cpd/kg/keV, null S_m at ~0.005
DAMA high-energy single-hit spectrum dominated by 40K (3.2 keV, 1461 keV) and 210Pb (46.5 keV)
variance of the cosine-amplitude estimator sigma_Sm^2 = 2B/(exposure dE) for uniform sampling

failed_or_abandoned: First compound shell command listing the DAMA folder aborted on a non-matching glob; re-issued.
A results-printing snippet keyed the CSV by '300.0' rather than '300' (formatting) and failed; fixed. No physics impact.
WimPyDD's wimp_dd_rate on the DAMA experiment object was not used (writes response-function files; bins end at 16 keVee); diff_rate with the DAMA target served for validation only.
No data request filed: a HEPData-style DAMA S_m table would refine the comparison by < x2 against a 4-5 order-of-magnitude discrepancy.
